question: In the 2024 Jharkhand Assembly elections, how many seats were won by the winning party/coalition and what is the name of the party/coalition?
solution:
The correct answer is __**56 seats, JMM-led alliance INDIA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The JMM-led alliance INDIA secured a total of **56 seats** in the 2024 Jharkhand Assembly elections, ensuring a majority in the 81-member Assembly.
 
• The alliance was composed of the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM), Indian National Congress (INC), and Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD), among others.
 
• The JMM, under the leadership of Chief Minister Hemant Soren, played a pivotal role in consolidating votes from tribal and rural regions of the state.
 
• The alliance's stronghold in areas with significant tribal populations and its welfare-focused initiatives contributed to its decisive victory.
 
• This election outcome reinforced the INDIA alliance's position as a significant opposition bloc in the context of Indian politics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jharkhand Assembly Elections:**

 
 
• The Jharkhand Legislative Assembly has 81 seats, and a party or coalition needs 41 seats to form a majority government.
 
• The state has a significant tribal population, which plays a crucial role in determining electoral outcomes.
 
 
 
• **JMM-led INDIA Alliance:**
 
 
• The INDIA alliance is a coalition of opposition parties at the national level, focusing on challenging the BJP-led NDA in various states.
 
• JMM's leadership in this alliance underscored its influence in Jharkhand politics.
 
 
 
• **2024 Political Landscape:**
 
 
• The 2024 elections were seen as a litmus test for the INDIA alliance's strength against the BJP.
 
• Regional alliances like the one in Jharkhand demonstrated the importance of localized strategies in national politics.
 
 
 
• **Voter Turnout:**
 
 
• Jharkhand witnessed a voter turnout of over 70%, showcasing the citizens' active participation in the democratic process.
 
• Tribal and rural voters formed a significant portion of the electorate.
